latency: Membership is the current assignment list. Bills are the latest referrals and meeting agendas on Congress.gov. Member votes are floor roll calls cast by this committee's members; committee markup tallies are not published as data.

committee.name: Senate Committee on Armed Services
committee.jurisdiction: The Senate Committee on Armed Services has legislative jurisdiction over military and defense.

bills.label: S 5598
bills.title: A bill to provide for an audit and mitigation of covered cellular modules in the Department of Defense systems and infrastructure.

bills.label: S 5590
bills.title: A bill to require the Secretary of Defense to submit a plan to identify, prioritize, and remediate the presence of certain equipment and computational facilities owned or controlled by a foreign adversary in the electric grid of the United States, and for other purposes.

bills.label: S 5599
bills.title: A bill to remove conditions on the use of certain land conveyed by the Department of the Army to the State of Indiana.

bills.label: S 5596
bills.title: A bill to modify provisions related to diversity, equity, and inclusion.

bills.label: S 5597
bills.title: A bill to promote the use of standardized testing at military service academies and DoDEA schools.

bills.label: S 5601
bills.title: A bill to require the Secretary of Defense to establish reporting requirements and voluntary guidance for large artificial intelligence contractors.

bills.label: S 5542
bills.title: A bill to establish objective standards, procedural protections, and independent review for the Secretary of Defense's removal of officers from promotion recommendations.

bills.label: S 5504
bills.title: A bill to require the Secretary of Defense to establish a pilot program on Department of Defense partnerships with institutions of higher education recognized in the National Centers of Academic Excellence in Cybersecurity program for Cyber Research, and for other purposes.

bills.label: S 5517
bills.title: A bill to authorize the Secretary of the Army to convey to the State of North Carolina a certain parcel of real property located at Fort Bragg, North Carolina, on which the State shall construct a veterans' State home, and for other purposes.

bills.label: S 5538
bills.title: A bill to direct the Secretary of the Navy to recognize certain aspects of the National Navy UDT-SEAL Museum in Fort Pierce, Florida, as a national memorial, national memorial garden, and national K9 memorial, and for other purposes.

bills.label: S 5555
bills.title: A bill to require the Secretary of Defense to initiate interim remedial actions with respect to perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances at certain installations of the Department of Defense, and for other purposes.

bills.label: SRES 869
bills.title: A resolution expressing the sense of the Senate that the third Friday of September should be recognized as "National POW/MIA Recognition Day".

meetings.title: To receive a closed briefing on an update on the budget of the Department of Defense.
